inputs.need: Set up a prospective study collecting PROMIS-29 and NRS at 1, 3, 6 and 12 months after all our lumbar RFAs, with weekly nurse telephone calls in the first month, so that we can publish our outcomes — and confirm that nobody else is already running this.
inputs.setting: Academic interventional chronic pain clinic, Hamilton, Ontario (Hamilton Health Sciences / McMaster).
inputs.constraints: Not known, and must stay unknown until the investigator supplies it: annual RFA volume; expected attrition at 12 months; whether an ongoing trial or registry already covers this; whether PROMIS-29 is licensed/available for this use locally.
localFacts: There is NO research nurse and NO funded research coordinator.
The PA performs two structured telephone follow-ups per patient at clinic-set times (roughly two weeks and three months).
There is no budget for participant compensation.
REB status for prospective PROM collection is NOT known; a trainee is available part-time.
